MAHALAGANG ABISO SA MGA MOTORISTA🚦

Asahan ang pagbagal ng daloy ng trapiko sa kahabaan ng Elliptical Road dahil sa inaasahang pagdagsa ng mga manonood sa Quezon City Countdown to 2026 na gaganapin sa Quezon Memorial Circle sa December 31, 2025 (Wednesday) simula 4:00 PM.

Magtutulungan at nakaantabay ang mga tauhan ng Traffic and Transport Management Department (TTMD), Department of Public Order and Safety (DPOS), Task Force Disiplina, Quezon City Police District (QCPD), at Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) para maisaayos ang inaasahang mabigat na daloy ng trapiko sa nasabing lugar.

Pinapayuhan ang mga motorista na dumaan sa mga alternatibong ruta.

Maraming salamat po sa inyong pang-unawa.

#QCNewYearCountdown2026
#NewYear2026

HEAVY TRAFFIC AS EDSA REHAB BEGINS

LOOK: Traffic was heavy along Epifanio delos Santos Avenue (EDSA) in Pasay City on Thursday, December 25, following the start of the Department of Public Works and Highways–National Capital Region (DPWH-NCR) rehabilitation project.

Heavy equipment was deployed as crews carried out reblocking of damaged sections and asphalt overlaying across the full width of EDSA from December 24 to 27.

📸 Jonas Sulit, Abante
